upload.none: Choose at least one file to upload.
upload.tooMany: Too many files in one request (max {{max}}).
upload.orgLimit_one: Your organization already has {{count}} document; the limit is {{max}}.

kb.title: Agent Knowledge Base
kb.seoDescription: Upload the policy documents your AI agents may quote when handling reports.

tour.sidebar: Upload the policies your AI agents should quote when they handle a report.
tour.upload: Drop policy files here, choose which agents may read them, then upload. Parsing and indexing takes up to a minute.
tour.table: Watch each document move from queued to ready. Change which agents can use it, or delete it, at any time.
tour.account: Manage your profile or log out from here.

kb.subtitleShort: Policy documents your AI agents may quote.
kb.subtitle: Policy documents your AI agents may quote when they triage and investigate reports.
kb.unavailableBody: Reports are still processed normally — the knowledge base is an enhancement, not a dependency.
kb.together: Agents combine what you upload here with each agent's own instructions on the <lnk>AI Agents</lnk> page. With neither, agents work from the report alone and say so plainly. Where the two conflict, your instructions win.
kb.viewOnlyBody: Your role can see the knowledge base but not change it. Uploading, reassigning and deleting documents needs permission to configure AI agents.
kb.noConsultingTitle: No agent can consult the knowledge base yet
kb.noConsulting: Documents are only useful once an agent can read them. Give an agent the "Consult the knowledge base" capability — and a role that allows “Consult policy documents” — then upload here.
kb.drop: Drop files here, or click to browse
kb.limits: Up to {{max}} files per upload, 10 MB each.
kb.allowedAgents: Agents allowed to use these documents
kb.allowedHint: Only agents that can consult the knowledge base are listed. Keep "every agent" unless a policy is only relevant to some of them.
kb.timing: Parsing and indexing a document takes 20–40 seconds. You can leave this page — ingestion continues on the server.
kb.staleTitle: Some documents are assigned to agents that can't read them
kb.orphanedTitle: Some documents are read by no agent
kb.stale_one: {{count}} document is assigned to agents that no longer exist or can no longer consult the knowledge base.
kb.stale_other: {{count}} documents are assigned to agents that no longer exist or can no longer consult the knowledge base.
kb.alsoOrphaned_one: {{count}} document is read by no agent at all.
kb.alsoOrphaned_other: {{count}} documents are read by no agent at all.
kb.orphaned_one: {{count}} document is ready but read by no agent, so it will never be quoted.
kb.orphaned_other: {{count}} documents are ready but read by no agent, so they will never be quoted.
kb.emptyBody: Agents will work from the report and your written instructions alone.
kb.orphanedTip: Indexed fine, but no agent can retrieve it.
kb.fewChunks: Very few searchable chunks — the file may be a scanned or image-only document.
kb.failedTitle: Some documents could not be indexed
kb.failedBody: A failed document is not used by any agent. If a PDF or Office file failed to parse, uploading a plain-text (.txt or .md) version of the same policy always works.
kb.confirmBody: "{{name}}" and every search index built from it will be removed permanently. Agents will stop quoting it immediately. This cannot be undone.

analyst.label: Analyst
analyst.description: Reads a report and reaches a decision that the workflow can branch on.

summarizer.label: Summarizer
summarizer.description: Writes a factual digest of the evidence. It reaches no decision and never contacts the reporter.

message_reporter.label: Message the reporter
message_reporter.description: Send messages the reporter can read.

internal_note.label: Write internal notes
internal_note.description: Leave notes only staff can see.

assign_report.label: Assign the report
assign_report.description: Hand the report to a member of staff.

read_attachments.label: Download evidence files
read_attachments.description: Open and read the contents of attached files. File names are visible either way.

resolve_escalation.label: Resolve escalation
resolve_escalation.description: Use the reporting hierarchy to work out who a report escalates to.

unverified.label: Unverified
unverified.note: This wording was not found in the cited document.

wrongDocument.label: Wrong document
wrongDocument.note: The quote is real, but it comes from a different document.

verified.label: Verified
verified.note: Found verbatim in the named document.

orgRequired: These settings belong to an organization. Sign in with an organization admin account to manage them.

validation.unknownPlaceholder: The greeting contains {{token}}, which is not a known placeholder. Use {{placeholder}} for the organization's name, or remove the braces.

voice.title: Voice Profile
voice.seoDescription: Set how the voice assistant introduces your organization on calls.
voice.loadFailedBody: The voice profile could not be loaded.
voice.fixFields: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
voice.saved: Saved — this applies from the next call.
voice.resetDone: Voice profile reset to the defaults.
voice.intro: How your voice agent introduces you on a call. Every field is optional — a blank one uses a sensible default — and changes apply from the next call.
voice.resetTitle: Clear the profile and use the defaults
voice.notAvailableBody: Viewing the voice profile needs a role that allows “View the voice profile”.
voice.superAdminHint: As a super admin you can edit any organization. Choose one to load its profile.
voice.firstHeardHint: Spoken as written. Callers who speak another language hear it translated for them.
voice.loadFailed: Could not load the voice profile
voice.usingDefaultsBody: Nothing has been saved for {{name}} yet. Callers hear the default greeting until you save a profile.
voice.viewOnlyBody: Your role can see the voice profile but not change it.
voice.nameHint: As the agent should say it. Leave blank to use your registered name, {{name}}.
voice.aboutHint: What your organization is and does. It helps the agent understand callers, and is never read out.
voice.aboutPlaceholder: e.g. A software company building AI products for enterprises.
voice.greetingHint: Write {{placeholder}} where the organization's name should go.
voice.greetingBlank: Leave blank for the default greeting shown below.
voice.insertTitle: Insert {{placeholder}}, which is replaced with the name callers know you by
voice.otherGreetings_one: {{count}} greeting in another language ({{languages}}) will be kept as it is.
voice.otherGreetings_other: {{count}} greetings in other languages ({{languages}}) will be kept as they are.
voice.unsaved: Unsaved changes · they apply from the next call
voice.resetConfirmBody: The name, background and greeting will be permanently cleared, and callers will hear the default greeting from the next call. This cannot be undone.

assignment.allAgents: Every agent that can consult the knowledge base
assignment.allAgentsHint: Includes agents given the capability later. Untick to choose specific agents.
assignment.noneWarning: With no agent selected, the document is stored but never used.

docRoles.staleTitle: This agent no longer exists or can no longer consult the knowledge base, so it can't use this document.
docRoles.modalTitle: Agents allowed to use this document
docRoles.immediate: Takes effect immediately. The document is not re-read or re-indexed, so there is nothing to wait for.

reconcile.title: Fix stale document assignments
reconcile.nothingBody: Every document is assigned only to agents that can read it.
reconcile.intro_one: These assignments point at agents that were deleted, deactivated, or can no longer consult the knowledge base. Applying removes them. Nothing is re-read or re-indexed. {{count}} other document is unaffected.
reconcile.intro_other: These assignments point at agents that were deleted, deactivated, or can no longer consult the knowledge base. Applying removes them. Nothing is re-read or re-indexed. {{count}} other documents are unaffected.
reconcile.widenedTitle_one: {{count}} document will be opened up to every agent
reconcile.widenedTitle_other: {{count}} documents will be opened up to every agent
reconcile.widenedBody: These would be left with no agent at all, so they are reassigned to every agent that can consult the knowledge base — a wider audience than before. Check them below, and narrow them afterwards if needed.
reconcile.consulting: Agents that can consult the knowledge base now: {{names}}.

mint.title: Create a token
mint.body: The multiagent service uses this token to act as the agent. It is shown once, so have somewhere safe ready to store it.

rotate.title: Rotate the token
rotate.body: A new token replaces the current one immediately. Anything still using the old token stops working until it is given the new one.

revoke.title: Revoke the token
revoke.body: The agent stops being able to act as soon as the token is revoked. You can create a new one later.

token.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the token and copy it manually.
token.stored: I've stored this token somewhere safe
token.onceTitle: This is the only time the token is shown
token.onceBody: Store it now — it cannot be recovered. Rotating replaces it immediately.

editor.sensitiveHint: No effect on AI agents: they always see answers marked sensitive as ••••.
editor.name: Name
editor.codeHintCreate: Workflow stages refer to the agent by this. It cannot be changed later.
editor.codeHintEdit: Codes cannot change — workflow stages refer to the agent by it.
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional — what this agent is for
editor.kindHintCreate: Fixed once the agent is created.
editor.kindHintEdit: The kind is fixed once an agent is created.
editor.permissionsSummarizerHint: Fixed for the summarizer — it doesn't act as a role.
editor.permissionsHint: An agent acts with a set of permissions, exactly like a person. You can only give it permissions you hold yourself.
editor.useRoleHint: The agent acts with that role's permissions and follows any change to it.
editor.customHint: Choose a set just for this agent.
editor.capabilitiesSummarizerHint: A summarizer can only do these three. It never messages the reporter, changes a report or routes it.
editor.capabilitiesHint: What the agent may do on a report. Each one only works while its permissions include the one it needs.
editor.wontWorkRole: Won't work yet: needs “{{permission}}” on the <role>{{role}}</role> role.
editor.chooseRoleToCheck: Choose a role to see whether this will work.
editor.wontWorkCustom: Won't work yet: add “{{permission}}” to this agent's permissions.
editor.decisionsHint: The verdicts this agent may return. Workflow stages branch on them, so keep them short and stable.
editor.noDecisionsWarning: With no decisions, a workflow can't branch on this agent — every run just moves on to the next step.
editor.instructionsHint: The organization's own guidance for this agent, in English.
editor.instructionsSummarizerPlaceholder: e.g. Lead with any amounts, dates and people named in the evidence.
editor.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Prioritise anything implicating a budget holder.
editor.summarizerSwitchOn: The summarizer is switched on and off in its own settings, on the Summarizer page — not here. It is currently on.
editor.summarizerSwitchOff: The summarizer is switched on and off in its own settings, on the Summarizer page — not here. It is currently off.
editor.activeHint: An inactive agent is skipped by every workflow.
editor.serviceDefault: Leave empty to use the service default.

run.formattingOnly: Formatting only — no readable text in this passage.
run.loadFailed: This run could not be loaded.
run.noSteps: No agent steps were recorded for this report.
run.unverified_one: {{count}} not found in the cited document
run.unverified_other: {{count}} not found in the cited document
run.noDocuments: No policy documents were consulted on this run.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The {{code}} agent and its token will be removed. This cannot be undone. To stop it for now instead, edit it and turn off Active.
delete.blockedTitle: This agent can't be deleted yet
delete.blockedBody: Remove it from every workflow stage that runs it first, then delete it.

capability.blockedRole: Turned on, but the {{role}} role doesn't include “{{permission}}”.
capability.blockedCustom: Turned on, but its custom permissions don't include “{{permission}}”.
capability.off: Not turned on for this agent.

stats.attentionHint: Switched off, or a capability is blocked

page.readsSummarizerTitle: The summarizer is cleared for every level. Its summary is a note on the same case, which only cleared staff can read.
page.readsTitle: An agent can read only the case levels its role is cleared for. Change that on the role's confidentiality permissions.
page.summariesBody: Your organization's one summarizer. It runs automatically before the first step of every workflow and its digest is given to every agent step — it is never a step itself.
page.noDecisions: None yet — workflows can't branch on this agent, so every run just moves on to the next step.
page.decisionsHint: Workflows can send a report somewhere different for each decision. Anything not branched on continues to the next step.
page.summarizerAsStep: The summarizer can't be a step — these are skipped when a report runs. Remove them from the workflow.
page.notAStepSummarizer: Not a step in any workflow, as it should be.
page.notAStep: Not a step in any workflow yet.
page.seeActivity: See what agents have done in AI Activity
page.instructionsIntro: Extra direction this agent follows on top of its built-in role. The Knowledge Base adds your policy documents.
page.noInstructionsBody: The agent works from its built-in behaviour and your policy documents.
page.tokenIssuedOn: Issued {{date}}. It is shown once when created; rotate it if it may have leaked.
page.tokenIssuedEarlier: Issued earlier. It is shown once when created; rotate it if it may have leaked.
page.noTokenBody: The agent runtime signs in with a token. Create one when you connect a runtime.
page.seoDescription: Define the AI agents that work your organization's reports.
page.title: AI Agents
page.intro: Each agent acts with the permissions of one of your roles and reaches the decisions your workflows branch on.
page.sensitiveNote: AI agents never see answers marked sensitive; they see •••• instead.
page.viewOnlyBody: Your role can see the agents but not change them. Changing them needs permission to configure AI agents.
page.emptyBody: Define an analyst to triage a report and reach a decision your workflows can branch on.
page.summariesOff: Summaries switched off. The other agents still run, on the report text alone.

activity.serviceDown: The AI agent service is not available right now.

tour.sidebar: See what each AI agent decided, and which policy it based that on.
tour.find: Search by report number or title, filter by decision, or load more of the history.
tour.table: Select a row to see what each agent did, the policy passages it relied on, and the outcome.

activity.subtitle: What the AI agents did on each report.
activity.intro: Every report your agents have worked on — what each one did, what it decided, and which policies it relied on.
activity.emptyBody: Once a report is processed by the AI agents, what they did and the policies they cited appear here.
activity.noMatchBody: Try a different search or decision.
activity.footer: Runs whose report is outside your organization are never listed.

summarizer.title: Summarizer
summarizer.intro: Writes a short, factual digest of each report's evidence files before the first workflow step, so every agent and person that follows starts from the facts. It never decides anything and never contacts the reporter.
summarizer.seoDescription: Turn the AI evidence digest on or off and choose how it summarizes.
summarizer.writesHint: Shorter digests are quicker to read; longer ones keep more detail from the evidence.

brief.label: Brief
brief.hint: A quick orientation — the key facts only.

standard.label: Standard
standard.hint: About a page — enough to start working the case.

detailed.label: Detailed
detailed.hint: Keeps more of the evidence, and takes longer to read.

summarizer.viewOnlyBody: Your role can see these settings but not change them. Changing them needs permission to configure AI agents.

status.running: Each new report with evidence files is summarized automatically, before the first step. Reports without attachments get no summary.
status.noEvidence: Switched on, but evidence files aren’t read — and they are all it summarizes, so no report will get a summary.
status.stalled: Switched on, but no report will get a summary until the problems below are fixed.
status.off: No report is summarized. Switching back on needs nothing else changed.
status.switchingOff: Switching off means {{stages}} will see no evidence digest. Those agents still run, on the report text alone.
status.whileOff: While this is off, {{stages}} get no evidence digest. Those agents still run, on the report text alone.

summarizer.customRange: Custom lengths can be anything from {{min}} to {{max}} words.
summarizer.readEvidenceHint: The digest is written from the report's attachments. Off, no report gets a summary.
summarizer.attachmentsOk: “{{capability}}” is on below, so this works.
summarizer.attachmentsNeeded: Also needs “{{capability}}” below — without it nothing is summarized.
summarizer.noAgent: There is no summarizer agent, so there is nothing to configure. The problem above explains how to fix it.
summarizer.missingNote: Digests reach your agents but don't appear in the case history. Turn on “{{capability}}” so staff can read them on the case.
summarizer.fixedPermissions: Fixed permissions, not borrowed from a role: {{list}}.
summarizer.whereRunsBody: Automatically, before the first step of every workflow. You don't add it as a step.
summarizer.noAgentSteps: The running workflow has no agent steps, so no agent reads the digest yet.
summarizer.offEffect: Turning summaries off means these steps start without a digest. It doesn't change the workflow, the agent or any role.
summarizer.preview: On a case, it looks like this
summarizer.previewBased: Based on the evidence files · only when a report has some
summarizer.previewNotWritten: Not written — evidence files aren’t read
